name: KRISHNA SANAKA

projects.name: IdSecure — Multi-Tenant Digital Credentials Platform (Product)
projects.stack: .NET Core · Node.js · Angular · MongoDB · SQL Server · Azure · Polygon · IPFS
bullets: Designed multi-tenant architecture so a single deployment serves multiple client organizations with isolated data.
Built the wallet and transaction primitives — creation, lifecycle, blockchain anchoring on Polygon, and audit trail.
Engineered the security layer: IPFS for tamper-evident document storage, Merkle proofs for verification, and RSA-encrypted user identifiers so internal logs never expose PII.
Implemented authentication and authorization with JWT and OAuth 2.0; delivered Angular admin UI with dynamic dashboards and configuration management.

projects.name: Yashcard — Client Deployment of IdSecure (Education sector)
projects.stack: .NET Core · Node.js · Angular · React · Azure Functions · Service Bus · SignalR · SendGrid · Twilio · FCM
bullets: Architected a multi-channel notification orchestration service in ASP.NET Core: in-app via SignalR, push via Azure Notification Hub with FCM fallback, email via SendGrid, SMS via Twilio — with per-channel background workers and bulk job tracking.
Built Excel-driven student onboarding using Azure Functions blob triggers that validate and organize incoming data, then fan rows into Service Bus queues for parallel wallet and transaction creation.
Built an on-demand export pipeline streaming Excel and PDF extracts via Azure Functions, with chunked writes through ExcelJS and Service Bus retries so memory stays flat regardless of dataset size.
Developed smart-card and certificate generation with pdf-lib, Puppeteer, and Jimp, embedding QR codes that link back to a verifier; outputs hashed and pinned to IPFS.
Integrated MKCL webhook ingest with a dynamically configurable field-mapping system, managed by non-developers through an Angular UI.
Tuned end-to-end retry, idempotency, and observability via Application Insights so failures are recoverable rather than silent.
